address: 6 Fisher Island Drive, Miami Beach, FL 33109
amenitiesDescription:
Six Fisher Island delivers over 55,000 SF of bespoke amenities across a private island setting with 650 linear feet of shoreline and gardens by Enea Garden Design. The Bayfront and Sunset pools each have an outdoor spa, sunbeds, and private cabanas, with poolside food and beverage service. The Sanctuary Spa features a sauna, hot and cold plunge pools, multiple treatment rooms, and a world-class salon.

The state-of-the-art fitness center overlooks Biscayne Bay with dedicated spaces for high-impact training, Pilates reformers, and a yoga studio. Dining options include the signature bayfront restaurant helmed by a celebrated chef, the Sunrise Lounge café, a private dining room and Chef's Table with a bespoke wine room, a speakeasy-style cocktail bar, and in-residence dining and catering. STARR Restaurants, led by James Beard Award-winning restaurateur Stephen Starr, will curate the culinary program at Six Fisher Island.

The amenities deck pairs a padel court with an imaginative children's playground, alongside two bayfront lounges, a multisport simulator game room and teen lounge, a boardroom equipped with advanced technology, and luxury guest suites for family and friends. A private dock with houseboat sits on the property; the Fisher Island Club's deep-water marina and luxury yacht harbour accommodate vessels up to 250 feet.

Service runs to a residential butler, a dedicated lifestyle concierge, an on-site general manager, 24-hour security and valet, and a house car and house tender to Miami Beach and the Watson Island Heliport. Every owner receives a complimentary golf cart; three dedicated parking spaces per residence cover two cars plus golf cart storage.

investmentIntelligence.thesis: Six Fisher Island occupies Fisher Island's final entitled condominium parcel: a 10-story, 50-residence building on America's wealthiest private island, accessible only by ferry. Fisher Island's average household income exceeds $2.2M, the highest of any ZIP code in the country. Palazzo della Luna, the island's last condo delivery in 2019, has seen resales more than double: one unit bought for $10.5M resold for $21.3M in 2022, at $4,811 per square foot. At 50 estate-scale residences with private pools, 10-foot ceilings, and lifetime club membership included, Six Fisher targets the top of the Miami market with a format the island is unlikely to repeat at this scale.

investmentThesis: Six Fisher occupies Fisher Island's final entitled condominium parcel: 6.5 acres with 650 linear feet of shoreline on the most exclusive private island community in the United States. The island has consistently ranked among the wealthiest ZIP codes in America. A complimentary lifetime Fisher Island Club membership at closing adds significant long-term value, as club memberships are independently priced in the hundreds of thousands. The island's ferry-only access creates a level of privacy and security unmatched by any mainland address. As of August 2026, construction is in its final stages: tower cranes have been removed, glass railings are progressing up the exterior, and the south amenities deck is taking shape with pool pours underway across the lower levels and villa residences. Two penthouses have closed for a combined $150 million among several major transactions at the development. Coastal Construction is overseeing delivery targeted for late 2026 or early 2027.

residenceContent: The final new development on Fisher Island, accessible only by private ferry or watercraft. The building rises 10 stories on a 6.5-acre waterfront site with 650 linear feet of shoreline, landscaped by Enea Garden Design. Just 50 estate-style residences served by three lobbies, each with a full-time concierge, with private elevator entry, 10-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling glass, and 15-foot-deep terraces. Interiors by Tara Bernerd & Partners use natural stone, warm timber, and a muted coastal palette to complement the island setting. Kitchens feature full Sub-Zero and Wolf appliance suites, custom cabinetry, and natural stone countertops. Primary suites include twin oversized walk-in wardrobes with custom built-ins. Every purchaser receives a complimentary lifetime Fisher Island Club membership at closing.
